humans communicate emotional states to the Haptic Creatures by touching it, and they do so in a way they expect the Haptic Creature to respond in kind.

how humans use touch to express emotions, how they expect robots to respond, and how they use touch to communicate higher-level intentions.
the human side of affective touch in human-robot interaction.
how affective touch is used to communicate emotions to a social robot.

the Haptic Creature is a useful platform to investigate the role of affective touch in human robot interaction.
affective touch is an important part of social interaction and that the Haptic Creature is a useful model of this interaction.
humans communicate emotional states to robots by touch and expect the robot to respond in kind.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Haptic Creature has a touch vocabulary and a set of expectations that are similar to humans.
affective touch interactions with social robots should be designed to be sensitive to the physical and emotional needs of the person and to the higher intent of the communication.
affective touch is a complex and nuanced form of communication, and that it is a critical element of human robot interactions.

humans are likely to employ a rich variety of affective gestures when communicating with a social robot.
affective touch is not only a physical act of communication but a social act that involves higher intent and expectation.
